title: Najaf, Kufa & Uruk to Nasiriyah
full_text:
(Coach Bus) (Lunch OR Dinner is included)
7 AM After breakfast, head to Najaf
8:30 AM we will walk to the area of the shrine of Imam Ali, visit the Wadi Al Salam Cemetery and will have the chance to visit the grand bazaar of Najaf.
11 AM Head to Kufa for a short visit, visiting the Kufa mosque, one of the earliest mosques in the region.
12 PM, If time permits, have lunch at a restaurant, otherwise it will be take-away on the bus.
1 PM After that, head to Samawa and visit the UNESCO world heritage site, Uruk — an ancient city of Sumer that played a leading role in the early urbanization.
Writing may have originated in Uruk around 3300 BC.
Evidence from excavations includes extensive pottery and the earliest known tablets of writing.
5 PM Head to Nasiriyah afterwards
7 PM check-in to the hotel.
